text: APPROVE. The extracted code keeps the original logic (the nested `?:` chain becomes `NestDecision` with the same ordering, and `classAt` stands in for `i`), and moving the nested per-method loop into `NestControllerRoutes` should drop `Nest` well under 15. I could only see the diff, so the build and the exact complexity score are unverified. The `List<Decorator>` parameter type is the one thing that could break the build if `classDecorators` is declared as something else.
